name: L250 OCI-MSA Gen2 TX electrical eye mask
compliance_note: Internal OCI-MSA Gen2 pad-level mask; geometry follows the OIF-CEI TX mask construction but this is not a CEI compliance claim.
test_point: Differential TX microbump pad (V_TXP - V_TXN) before optical modulation, extracted 60 fF MRM-plus-pad load present
alignment: Eye folded over 1 UI against the ideal (jitter-free) serializer symbol clock; phase chosen so the mean 0 V differential crossing sits at t = 0 UI (eye center at 0.5 UI). Recovered-clock alignment is not permitted: it would hide DCD/DDJ already budgeted in §3-1.
pass_fail: Zero samples inside the inner hexagon and zero samples with |v| > Y2 over the full observation set (provisional: >= 1e6 UI per corner, PRBS13 and PRBS31, both FFE banks, tap-code extrema, PVT corners, simultaneous-lane activity)

status.X1: provisional — derived as TJ_pp/2 = 0.28/2 UI (spec §3-1); TBD_from_link_budget
status.X2: provisional — CEI-56G-XSR-NRZ shoulder value, pending validation against the 3.2-4.5 ps transition-time envelope; TBD_from_sim_sweep
status.Y1: provisional placeholder — pending derivation from the MRM P(V) transfer at the committed bias (ER >= 3.5 dB, OMA, TDEC) plus PVT/noise margin; TBD_from_link_budget
status.Y2: provisional — set to V_PP,max/2 = 1.5 V (hard-clip bound, spec §4-1); supersedes the earlier 600 mV placeholder, which is inconsistent with a 2.0-3.0 Vppd swing under the standard CEI mask construction; TBD_from_partner

budget_decomposition.note: Horizontal decomposition is exact dual-Dirac from the spec §3-1 allocations; vertical is provisional (SNDR-only error bound, no committed vertical ISI/ripple budget).
